interface.shortDescription: FDK setup, Platform 3.0 apps, AI Actions, and marketplace publish.
interface.longDescription: Cursor plugin root for Freshworks skills: fw-setup (FDK/nvm), fw-app-dev (Platform 3.0 apps), fw-ai-actions-app (AI Actions), fw-publish (MCP). Copy **`.mcp.json`** from this repository into project **`.cursor/mcp.json`** and set **Authorization** to `Bearer <token>`. API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/ - API key for Freddy AI Copilot for VS Code plugin & AI Developer Tools. or Connect to Developer MCP server (For MCP configuration).
